hook: Micron found a simple fix for sloppy analog AI chips.
sections: It is weight splitting: spreading each AI weight across several memory cells.
Think of Olympic diving judges. One judge may be off, but averaging several gives a fair score.
First, each weight is stored across several cells. Second, their errors average out.
Before, analog chips were efficient but unreliable.
Now accuracy improves with a simple method.
A memory giant solving accuracy suggests products follow. Micron is the direct beneficiary. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
